subject.title: fix(commands): restore bare /new and /reset model fallthrough

question: Should bare `/new` and `/reset` universally invoke a startup/model turn, retain explicit acknowledgements, or use a documented source-specific policy for direct and group chat surfaces?
rationale: The proposed global handler change conflicts with an open sibling proposal for explicit group acknowledgements, and neither proof establishes that one behavior is correct for every caller.

options.title: Define a source-aware reset contract
options.body: Specify direct, group, native slash, hook-routed, tail, and ACP behavior, then refresh this PR or a replacement against current main with tests for that matrix.

options.title: Adopt universal fallthrough
options.body: Accept model-startup turns for every bare reset caller and update user-facing command behavior and coverage accordingly.

options.title: Retain universal acknowledgements
options.body: Keep the existing terminal acknowledgement policy and close this regression direction if greetings are not the desired reset contract.

recommendation.title: Define a source-aware reset contract
recommendation.body: Specify direct, group, native slash, hook-routed, tail, and ACP behavior, then refresh this PR or a replacement against current main with tests for that matrix.

likelyOwner.reason: The available reset-history trail and explicit PR routing most strongly connect this person to the original reset semantics.
